verdict.rationale: The Empresa Online service page states the operating-hours position up front: incorporation is possible at any time. It also publishes the flow's time windows: a 24-hour name reservation until payment, 48 hours to pay after submission, and 5 days to correct issues. It says nothing about a session timeout or per-day limits, so it is unclear whether every limit is disclosed before starting. Missing for 10: published session-timeout duration, statement on per-day submission limits or their absence, independent or hands-on confirmation that the disclosed windows match the live flow.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
